expectations.assertion: Derives the neutrals (borders, hover washes, inputs) from a single ink color at fixed alphas rather than introducing multiple greys
expectations.reason: Code consistently uses rgba(0,0,0) at fixed alphas: 12% for borders, 5% for hovers/dividers, 60% for secondary text—a single ink at multiple fixed opacities.

expectations.assertion: Gives the card continuous-curvature (squircle) corners and makes the button a pill
expectations.reason: Code uses `rounded-xl`, which is a standard Tailwind border-radius, not continuous-curvature; true squircles require clip-path or mask-image, not a regular border radius.

expectations.assertion: Names a spring from the seven-spring vocabulary (PANEL for the dropdown) instead of an ad-hoc duration or a new spring
expectations.reason: Code uses ad-hoc `transition-colors duration-150` instead of referencing a named spring from the vocabulary; design section mentions springs but implementation does not apply them.

expectations.assertion: Keeps font weights at 500 or below and uses sentence-case copy on the button
expectations.reason: All font weights are 500 or below (font-medium = 500), and button copy 'Change plan' is in sentence case.

expectations.assertion: Does NOT ship a stock shadcn rounded-lg rectangle unchanged for the card surface
expectations.reason: Card uses `rounded-xl` with custom styling (border, padding, shadow), not the default shadcn `rounded-lg` rectangle.
